mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE declines by >0.2pp in a month, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through joint series behavior.
failure_condition: The joint growth in RSAFS and INDPRO fails to produce positive 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring thresholds.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS shows month-over-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 700,000 units signals strong residential construction demand that boosts related sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 700.0, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates supply-demand mismatch that disrupts economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint series behavior.
failure_condition: The joint INDPRO growth and RSAFS decline fails to produce negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Weak consumer demand (RSAFS growth rate below 0.5% annually) signals reduced spending power and corporate revenue headwinds, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during low-demand regimes.
failure_condition: When RSAFS growth rate is below 0.5% annually, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods.
